    from `project-7781a5d3-3f4e-4cd5-a43`.`olist_dev_staging`.`stg_order_reviews`

ranked_reviews as (
    select
        review_id,
        order_id,
        review_score,
        review_answer_timestamp,

        row_number() over (

                review_id desc

    from reviews

    review_score,
    review_answer_timestamp,
    review_sequence = 1 as latest_review
from ranked_reviews

with delivered_orders as (

        order_purchase_timestamp,
        order_delivered_customer_date
    from `project-7781a5d3-3f4e-4cd5-a43`.`olist_dev_core`.`fct_orders`
    where order_status = 'delivered'
      and order_purchase_timestamp is not null
      and order_delivered_customer_date is not null
),

latest_reviews as (
    select
        order_id,
        review_score
    from `project-7781a5d3-3f4e-4cd5-a43`.`olist_dev_core`.`fct_order_reviews`
    where latest_review = true
)

select
    o.order_id,
    timestamp_diff(
        o.order_delivered_customer_date,
        o.order_purchase_timestamp,
        day
    ) as days_to_deliver,
    r.review_score

from delivered_orders as o
inner join latest_reviews as r
    on o.order_id = r.order_id
